_comment: Manifest entries outside nightly_matrix.json, run by .github/workflows/regression-extended.yml: weekly always, daily only when the account's Actions queue is idle. Must be manifest names, disjoint from the nightly list.

_excluded.tada-codec: covered by tada-tts-3b-ml, which decodes through the same pinned tada-codec-f16.gguf via --codec-model; tada-ref.gguf in the repo is a voice prompt, not a reference dump, so no standalone stage diff is possible
_excluded.kugelaudio-0-open: TTS roundtrip runs but output is largely garbled (run 42821278216: WER 1.33, 'Shit fellow, the book is going to be frown fox jumps over the daisy card') - real quality issue to investigate before gating
_excluded.f5-tts-v1-base: synthesis of one sentence exceeds 1200 s on the 4-vCPU GH runner (run 42820528553) - CPU performance issue, not a correctness verdict
_excluded.tada-tts-3b-ml: synthesis succeeds with the pinned tada-codec via --codec-model but the roundtrip transcript is empty (WER 1.0, run 42820528553) - real output problem to investigate
_excluded.parler-tts-mini-v1.1: roundtrip garbled with or without --voice (no_voice: 'a quick brown fuck star of a little lane dog', WER 0.78 vs max 0.2, run 42820528553) - real quality problem to investigate
